long_biography.plain_text:
Chemical engineering provided the foundation for Riad Zein’s career in liquid gases. He completed postgraduate study in integrated chemical plant design and worked briefly in Kuwait’s petrochemical industry before entering the family business. His wider maritime involvement included service on marine insurer the UK P&I Club’s board, alongside executives from other international shipping companies.

Zein and his wife, Rana, have also supported contemporary art. They were main patrons of Lebanon’s pavilion at the 2024 Venice Biennale. The pavilion presented Mounira Al Solh’s multidisciplinary work, combining painting, drawing, embroidery, video and performance.
